customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile

name.meaning: customer's full name as on the profile

phone_number.meaning: registered mobile number on the profile

email.meaning: registered email address on the profile

date_of_birth.meaning: customer's date of birth as given on the profile or card application

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the Social Security number on file (captured with a card application; empty for customers who never applied)

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the billing/mailing address on file

mailing_address.meaning: mailing address on file, as one line

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the customer profile was created

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record (one per customer)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; never goes back from true to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt recorded

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

card_account_id.meaning: primary id of the card account record

variant_name.meaning: the card product and status currently held, written as the official card name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the account (basis defined in the card charter lifecycle)

opened_date.meaning: approval date on which the account opened; empty while applied or when declined

closed_date.meaning: date the account was closed, charged off or the application declined; empty while applied, active or restricted

card_last4.meaning: last four digits of the card number currently issued; empty while applied

credit_limit.meaning: current credit line of the account

current_balance.meaning: amount owed now, identically the sum of the revolving_balance deltas (charges positive, credits negative); a negative value is a credit balance

statement_closing_day.meaning: day of the month on which each billing cycle closes

autopay_option.meaning: AutoPay amount instruction in force; none when not enrolled

autopay_fixed_amount.meaning: fixed AutoPay amount when autopay_option is fixed_amount; 0.00 otherwise

last_credit_limit_change_date.meaning: date the credit line last changed; empty if never changed since opening

status_review_date.meaning: date of the annual status review that last changed the card status; empty if never changed

card_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the card transaction

card_account_id.meaning: card account the transaction posted to (foreign key -> card_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the card charter

txn_date.meaning: date the transaction occurred (for payments, the date credited after the cut-off rule); empty for interest

post_date.meaning: date the transaction posted to the account

amount.meaning: magnitude of the transaction; whether it raises or lowers the balance is fixed by event_type (purchases, fees, interest, returned payments, rebills and refunds raise it; payments and credits lower it)

merchant_name.meaning: merchant name as printed on the statement; empty for non-purchase transactions

merchant_category.meaning: merchant category of a purchase; not_applicable for non-purchase transactions

order_number.meaning: Marlowe & Finch order or register receipt number of a purchase charge (shared by the purchase records of that order); empty otherwise

purchase_id.meaning: Marlowe & Finch purchase record refunded or price-adjusted by a merchandise credit (foreign key -> purchases); empty otherwise

order_event_id.meaning: Marlowe & Finch refund or price adjustment record settled by a merchandise credit (foreign key -> order_events); empty otherwise

return_id.meaning: return record refunded by a merchandise credit (foreign key -> return_requests); empty otherwise

original_card_txn_id.meaning: the earlier card transaction this one reverses, refunds, disputes or was caused by (another card_txn_id); empty when none

statement_period.meaning: billing period the transaction belongs to, named by the month of its closing date

promo_plan.meaning: special financing plan on a purchase; none otherwise

welcome_discount_amount.meaning: welcome discount taken off a purchase; 0.00 when none

payment_channel.meaning: channel of a payment; not_applicable for other transactions

fee_type.meaning: type of fee assessed or reversed; not_applicable for other transactions

reversal_reason.meaning: why a fee was reversed; not_applicable for other transactions

interest_type.meaning: kind of interest charge; not_applicable for other transactions

dispute_credit_kind.meaning: whether a dispute credit is temporary during investigation or final; not_applicable for other transactions

refund_method.meaning: how a credit balance was refunded; not_applicable for other transactions

statement_id.meaning: primary id of the monthly statement record

card_account_id.meaning: card account the statement belongs to (foreign key -> card_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the card charter

statement_period.meaning: billing period, named by the month of the closing date

payment_due_date.meaning: payment due date printed on the statement

statement_balance.meaning: new balance at the closing date; negative for a credit balance

minimum_payment_due.meaning: minimum payment due by the payment due date

past_due_amount.meaning: unpaid minimum payments from earlier statements included in the minimum due

disputed_amount_excluded.meaning: amount under an open billing dispute excluded from the minimum payment

promo_balance.meaning: remaining special financing balance at the closing date

dispute_id.meaning: primary id of the dispute record (one per filing, resolution or withdrawal)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the card charter

disputed_card_txn_id.meaning: the posted card transaction in dispute (a card_txn_id); the object key of the dispute

dispute_reason.meaning: billing error asserted in the notice

disputed_amount.meaning: amount the cardmember says is in error

notice_date.meaning: date the billing-error notice was received

first_statement_date.meaning: statement date of the first statement on which the disputed transaction appeared; recorded on the filing row

outcome.meaning: pending on a filing row; the result on a resolution or withdrawal row

resolution_date.meaning: date of resolution or withdrawal; empty on a filing row

card_request_id.meaning: primary id of the card service request

card_account_id.meaning: card account the request concerns (foreign key -> card_accounts)

requested_credit_limit.meaning: credit line requested on a credit_line_increase request; 0.00 otherwise

replacement_speed.meaning: delivery speed chosen on a card_replacement request; not_applicable otherwise

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

membership_id.meaning: primary id of the Finch Circle membership record

variant_name.meaning: tier currently held, written as the official tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership (basis defined in the loyalty charter lifecycle)

member_number.meaning: Finch Circle member number printed in the app and on receipts

closed_date.meaning: date the membership was cancelled or terminated; empty while active or suspended

tier_valid_through.meaning: last date the current tier is held without requalifying (31 December of the year after it was earned; empty for Finch Circle Member)

last_tier_change_date.meaning: date of the most recent tier change; empty if the tier never changed

last_tier_change_type.meaning: kind of the most recent tier change; none if the tier never changed

points_balance.meaning: current points, identically the sum of the points account deltas

notes_balance.meaning: value of unexpired, unredeemed Finch Notes, identically the sum of the finch_notes account deltas

alteration_credit_balance.meaning: alteration credit available for the current calendar year, identically the sum of the alteration_credit account deltas

loyalty_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the points ledger entry

membership_id.meaning: membership the points belong to (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the loyalty charter

points.meaning: magnitude of the entry; earn and adjustment add, reversal, conversion and expiry subtract

earn_source.meaning: what the points were earned for; not_applicable on reversal, conversion and expiry rows

purchase_id.meaning: purchase record the entry relates to (foreign key -> purchases); empty when none

card_txn_id.meaning: card transaction a card bonus or outside-spend entry relates to (foreign key -> card_transactions); empty when none

return_id.meaning: return record a reversal relates to (foreign key -> return_requests); empty when none

qualifying_amount.meaning: net qualifying dollars the points were computed on; 0.00 for fixed bonuses and non-earn rows

original_loyalty_entry_id.meaning: for a reversal, the earn or adjustment entry (another loyalty_entry_id) whose points are taken back; empty otherwise

note_code.meaning: for a conversion, the code of the Finch Note created; empty otherwise

expiry_reason.meaning: why points were forfeited; not_applicable on other rows

note_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the Finch Note ledger entry

membership_id.meaning: membership holding the note (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the loyalty charter

note_code.meaning: unique code of the Finch Note (FN- followed by 8 characters), the object key of the note

note_amount.meaning: value of the note issued, consumed or lapsed

issue_reason.meaning: why a note was issued; not_applicable on redeem and expire rows

issue_date.meaning: date a note was issued; empty on redeem and expire rows

expiry_date.meaning: last day the note can be redeemed; recorded on issue rows

txn_date.meaning: date a note was redeemed or lapsed; empty on issue rows

purchase_id.meaning: purchase record a note was redeemed on (foreign key -> purchases); empty otherwise

return_id.meaning: return record that caused a reinstatement note (foreign key -> return_requests); empty otherwise

original_note_code.meaning: for a reinstatement or courtesy reissue, the code of the note being replaced; empty otherwise

expire_reason.meaning: why a note lapsed; not_applicable on other rows

benefit_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the alteration credit ledger entry

membership_id.meaning: membership holding the credit (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the loyalty charter

benefit_year.meaning: calendar year the alteration credit belongs to

amount.meaning: magnitude of the entry; grant and restore add, use and expire subtract

ticket_id.meaning: alteration ticket the credit was used on or restored from (foreign key -> alteration_tickets); empty otherwise

grant_reason.meaning: why credit was granted; not_applicable on other rows

loyalty_request_id.meaning: primary id of the Finch Circle service request

membership_id.meaning: membership the request concerns (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships)

purchase_id.meaning: purchase record named in a missing_points request (foreign key -> purchases); empty otherwise

note_code.meaning: code of the expired note named in an expired_note_reissue request; empty otherwise

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

purchase_id.meaning: primary id of the purchase record (one unit of one item in one order or register transaction)

variant_name.meaning: merchandise class of the item, written as the official class name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the purchase record (basis defined in the order charter lifecycle)

order_number.meaning: order number (online, app, phone) or register receipt number (store) printed on the receipt or confirmation, shared by every purchase record of that transaction

purchase_date.meaning: date of the order or register transaction

fulfillment.meaning: how the unit reaches the customer

item_description.meaning: item name as printed on the receipt

regular_price.meaning: ticketed regular price of the unit

unit_price.meaning: selling price of the unit after promotions and allocated coupons, before Finch Notes and tax

price_type.meaning: price status of the unit at purchase

tax_amount.meaning: sales tax charged on the unit

finch_notes_applied.meaning: Finch Note value allocated to the unit; 0.00 when none

tender_type.meaning: tender the unit was paid with (besides Finch Notes)

card_account_id.meaning: Marlowe & Finch card account charged (foreign key -> card_accounts); empty when no Marlowe & Finch card was used

registry_id.meaning: gift registry the unit was bought from as a gift (foreign key -> registries); empty otherwise

gift_receipt.meaning: whether a gift receipt was issued for the unit

membership_linked.meaning: whether a Finch Circle number was captured on the transaction

ship_date.meaning: date the unit shipped; empty when not shipped

completed_date.meaning: delivery, pickup or carry-out date; empty until completed

cancelled_date.meaning: date the unit was cancelled; empty otherwise

cancellation_reason.meaning: why the unit was cancelled; none when not cancelled

returned_date.meaning: date the returned unit was received and accepted; empty otherwise

net_paid_amount.meaning: amount paid for the unit and not refunded, identically the sum of the net_paid account deltas

order_event_id.meaning: primary id of the payment, price adjustment, refund or comfort exchange record

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the order charter

event_date.meaning: date the payment was captured, the adjustment granted, the refund issued or the exchange booked

amount.meaning: magnitude of the record; a payment adds to net paid, an adjustment or refund takes from it; 0.00 on a comfort exchange

tender_type.meaning: tender captured on a payment; not_applicable on other records

new_unit_price.meaning: lower Marlowe & Finch price a price adjustment is based on; empty on other records

adjustment_reason.meaning: basis of a price adjustment; not_applicable on other records

return_id.meaning: return record refunded or exchanged (foreign key -> return_requests); empty otherwise

refund_trigger.meaning: what caused a refund; not_applicable on other records

refund_destination.meaning: where a refund went; not_applicable on other records

refund_tender_type.meaning: tender refunded when a refund or price adjustment went to the original tender; not_applicable otherwise

restocking_fee_amount.meaning: restocking fee deducted from a refund; 0.00 when none

return_fee_amount.meaning: prepaid label or carrier pickup fee deducted from a refund; 0.00 when none

gwp_deduction_amount.meaning: value of a kept gift with purchase deducted from a refund; 0.00 when none

tax_refunded.meaning: sales tax included in a refund or price adjustment; 0.00 otherwise

replacement_purchase_id.meaning: purchase record of the replacement mattress on a comfort exchange (another purchase_id); empty otherwise

return_id.meaning: primary id of the return record (one unit)

customer_id.meaning: customer returning the unit (foreign key -> customers); for a gift return, the recipient or registrant returning it

purchase_id.meaning: purchase record being returned (foreign key -> purchases)

return_method.meaning: how the unit is being returned

receipt_type.meaning: proof of purchase presented or found

item_condition.meaning: condition of the unit as declared at authorization and confirmed on receipt

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: moment the return was authorized; its date part is the return date used for windows

registry_id.meaning: primary id of the gift registry record

variant_name.meaning: registry type, written as the official registry type name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the registry (basis defined in the registry charter lifecycle)

registry_number.meaning: public registry number guests search by

event_date.meaning: current date of the occasion (for a baby registry, the due or arrival date); the anchor of the completion period, rewards payout and registry return window

original_event_date.meaning: event date first registered; never changes

event_date_change_count.meaning: number of event date changes made

closed_date.meaning: date the registry closed or was cancelled; empty otherwise

co_registrant_name.meaning: co-registrant's name as given; empty when none

visibility.meaning: whether guests can find the registry by name search

registry_rewards_balance.meaning: rewards accrued and not yet paid out, identically the sum of the registry_rewards account deltas

registry_credit_balance.meaning: registry credit available, identically the sum of the registry_credit account deltas

registry_event_id.meaning: primary id of the registry ledger record

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the registry charter

sku.meaning: item number concerned; empty on money-only records

requested_quantity.meaning: requested quantity of the sku after an item add; empty on other records

purchase_id.meaning: purchase record concerned (foreign key -> purchases); empty when none

return_id.meaning: return record concerned (foreign key -> return_requests); empty when none

amount.meaning: money magnitude of the record: gift price, completion discount, rewards or credit moved; empty on item adds

completion_discount_pct.meaning: total completion percent applied on a completion purchase; empty otherwise

registry_request_id.meaning: primary id of the registry service request

purchase_id.meaning: purchase record named in a gift_link request (foreign key -> purchases); empty otherwise

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

ticket_id.meaning: primary id of the alteration ticket (one garment)

customer_id.meaning: customer who dropped off the garment (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: service class of the work, written as the official class name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the ticket (basis defined in the alteration charter lifecycle)

ticket_number.meaning: alteration ticket number printed on the customer's claim stub

garment_description.meaning: garment as described on the ticket

purchase_id.meaning: Marlowe & Finch purchase record of the garment (foreign key -> purchases); empty when the garment was not bought at Marlowe & Finch

dropoff_date.meaning: date the garment was dropped off

promised_date.meaning: date the garment is currently promised ready

needed_by_date.meaning: date the customer needs the garment; empty when not recorded

rush_service.meaning: whether rush service applies to the ticket

quoted_total.meaning: total of the operation charges quoted at drop-off, before waivers

ready_date.meaning: date the garment last became ready; empty before

pickup_date.meaning: date the garment was last collected; empty before

cancelled_date.meaning: date the ticket was cancelled; empty otherwise

remake_count.meaning: number of remakes accepted on the ticket

balance_due.meaning: amount owed on the ticket, identically the sum of the ticket_balance account deltas

alteration_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the charge, waiver, payment, refund or settlement record

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the alteration charter

amount.meaning: magnitude of the record; charges and refunds raise the ticket balance, waivers and payments lower it; a damage settlement does not touch the balance

charge_type.meaning: kind of charge, or damage_compensation on a settlement; not_applicable on waivers, payments and refunds

operation_code.meaning: operation charged on operation and lined_surcharge rows; not_applicable otherwise

fitting_number.meaning: ordinal of an extra fitting charged; 0 on other records

waiver_reason.meaning: why a charge was waived; not_applicable on other records

original_alteration_charge_id.meaning: the charge waived or the payment refunded (another alteration_charge_id); empty otherwise

payment_kind.meaning: whether a payment was the drop-off deposit or the pickup balance; not_applicable otherwise

tender_type.meaning: tender of a payment or refund; not_applicable otherwise

delivery_id.meaning: primary id of the home delivery booking

customer_id.meaning: customer receiving the delivery (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: service level, written as the official service level name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the booking (basis defined in the delivery charter lifecycle)

order_number.meaning: order number whose items are delivered (shared with the purchase records of that order)

stairs_flights.meaning: flights of stairs to reach the placement point

distance_miles.meaning: road miles from the delivery center to the address

haul_away_items.meaning: items to be hauled away; 0 when none

arrival_time.meaning: time the team arrived on the delivered attempt; empty otherwise

failure_cause.meaning: cause of the latest failed attempt; none when no attempt failed

cancellation_cause.meaning: why the booking was cancelled; none otherwise

charges_balance.meaning: net delivery charges, identically the sum of the delivery_charges account deltas

delivery_event_id.meaning: primary id of the delivery charge or credit record

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the delivery charter

amount.meaning: charges add to the delivery charges, credits take from them

charge_type.meaning: kind of charge; not_applicable on credits

credit_reason.meaning: why a credit was given; not_applicable on charges

original_delivery_event_id.meaning: the charge a credit applies to (another delivery_event_id); empty for charges and late arrival credits

delivery_claim_id.meaning: primary id of the delivery claim

purchase_id.meaning: purchase record of a missing or damaged item (foreign key -> purchases); empty for home damage

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

gift_card_id.meaning: primary id of the gift card record (one card number)

customer_id.meaning: customer the card is issued to or registered to (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: card kind, written as the official card name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the card (basis defined in the gift card charter lifecycle)

card_number.meaning: card number printed on the card or in the eGift email

activation_date.meaning: date the card was activated; empty while inactive

expiry_date.meaning: last day a card that expires can be redeemed; empty for cards that do not expire

registered.meaning: whether the card is registered to the customer's profile for balance protection

frozen_date.meaning: date the card was last reported lost or stolen; empty otherwise

closed_date.meaning: date the card number was closed; empty otherwise

balance.meaning: value available, identically the sum of the card_balance account deltas

gc_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the gift card ledger record

customer_id.meaning: customer of the card (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the gift card charter

amount.meaning: value moved; issues, reloads and transfers in add to the balance, the others take from it

issue_reason.meaning: why a card was issued; not_applicable on other records

return_id.meaning: return record refunded onto the card or whose qualifying purchase forfeited a bonus (foreign key -> return_requests); empty otherwise

registry_id.meaning: registry paid out or converted (foreign key -> registries); empty otherwise

purchase_id.meaning: purchase record paid by a redemption or that qualified for a bonus card (foreign key -> purchases); empty otherwise

counterpart_gift_card_id.meaning: the other card of a transfer (another gift_card_id); empty otherwise
